attributes.additional_details: The UK currently relies on the voluntary Child Rescue Alert system, which requires citizens to manually opt-in to receive text messages. We want the Government to mandate that high-urgency missing child alerts are automatically broadcast directly to all mobile phones within specific geographic areas using the UK’s existing Emergency Alerts network, The general public wants to help protect vulnerable children, but they cannot do so if they are unaware a child is missing nearby.
attributes.background: To create and implement a missing child early alert system for the uk when a child goes missing every second counts

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Establish a national alert system for missing autistic & vulnerable people
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778218

Use emergency phone alerts to help find missing children in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/782158
